findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/host-run-usage.md:60-63 says every host subprocess executes in the resolved project root, but public host_run --managedReview enables isolateManagedReview (packages/main/src/handlers/host-run.ts:405-407), creates a detached scratch worktree, seals that scratch as spec.cwd (packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1762-1793), and launches the provider from spec.cwd (packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:2138-2147). Document ordinary runs versus formal managed-review execution so operators do not expect reviewer code to run in the primary worktree.
